``` ::: ::: ::: callout-note ### Key Finding The anomalous post is event ID 373902, posted at 2046-05-17T11:21:15Z but this is in UTC which in US Eastern time is on 4.21am, which matches the challenge description. In addition `details.forum`:`general` coincide with the challenge description that its posted in a random forum. ::: ## SaidIT post timeline ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} saidit_posts <- mc2_events %>% filter(short_name %in% c("saidit_post", "post_saidit")) %>% mutate( is_anomalous = id == 373902, post_date = as.Date(datetime), label = if_else(id == 373902, "Anomalous\nJohn Windward\npost", NA_character_) ) ggplot(data = saidit_posts, aes(x = datetime, y = short_name, colour = is_anomalous, size = is_anomalous)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.8) + geom_vline(xintercept = as.POSIXct("2046-05-17 11:21:15", tz = "UTC"), colour = "#e15759", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) + ggrepel::geom_label_repel( aes(label = label), na.rm = TRUE, fill = "#e15759", colour = "white", size = 3, fontface = "bold", nudge_y = 0.4, segment.colour = "#e15759" ) + scale_colour_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = "#e15759"), labels = c("Normal post", "Anomalous post")) + scale_size_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 1.5, "TRUE" = 4), guide = "none") + labs(title = "All SaidIT-related Posts Over Time", subtitle = "John Windward's autonomous post on May 17 stands out as the only anomaly", x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = NULL) + theme_minimal() + theme( plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13), legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Take_Home_Ex2_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-10-1.png){width=672} ::: ::: ## Conclusion on the anomalous post The post has `short_name` as `saidit_post` but under `parties` as `Agent/person:john_windward,system:saidit` which is weird as concluded that `saidit_post` should be posted by the person so John himself. But `parties` shows that its posted by John's agent instead. In addition based on John's event on May 17, there was only `check_email`. He was also not active on 4:21 am, which means his agent acted autonomously. # Organisational Context ## Inspect nodes and edges only ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} org_nodes <- as_tibble(org_raw$nodes) org_edges <- as_tibble(org_raw$edges) glimpse(org_nodes) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Rows: 75 Columns: 4 $ id "company:tenant_thread", "department:executive_suite", "departme… $ label "Tenant Thread", "Executive Suite", "Products", "Human Resources… $ type "company", "department", "department", "department", "department… $ title NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, … ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} glimpse(org_edges) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Rows: 74 Columns: 3 $ source "company:tenant_thread", "company:tenant_thread", "company:te… $ target "department:executive_suite", "department:products", "departm… $ relation "contains", "contains", "contains", "contains", "contains", "… ``` ::: ::: ## Understanding John Windward ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} org_nodes %>% filter(str_detect(id, "john_windward")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 1 × 4 id label type title 1 person:john_windward John Windward person Department Lead ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} org_edges %>% filter(str_detect(source, "john_windward") | str_detect(target, "john_windward")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 1 × 3 source target relation 1 department:customer_support person:john_windward led_by ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} org_edges %>% filter(str_detect(source, "customer_support") | str_detect(target, "customer_support")) %>% left_join(org_nodes, by = c("target" = "id")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 6 × 6 source target relation label type title 1 company:tenant_thread department:customer_su… contains Cust… depa… 2 department:customer_support team:phone_center contains Phon… team 3 department:customer_support team:billing contains Bill… team 4 department:customer_support team:concierge contains Conc… team 5 department:customer_support team:public_relations contains Publ… team 6 department:customer_support person:john_windward led_by John… pers… Depa… ``` ::: ::: ::: callout-note ### Key Findings John leads Customer Support which contains 4 teams: Phone Center, Billing, Concierge and Public Relations. The Customer Support sits directly under `company:tenant_thread`. ::: ## Organisation chart visualisation ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} org_graph <- tbl_graph( nodes = org_nodes %>% mutate( highlight = case_when( id == "person:john_windward" ~ "John Windward", str_detect(id, "customer_support") ~ "Customer Support", type == "department" ~ "Department", type == "company" ~ "Company", TRUE ~ "Other" ) ), edges = org_edges %>% rename(from = source, to = target) %>% left_join(org_nodes %>% select(id), by = c("from" = "id")) %>% left_join(org_nodes %>% select(id), by = c("to" = "id")), directed = TRUE ) ggraph(org_graph, layout = "tree") + geom_edge_diagonal(colour = "grey70", arrow = arrow(length = unit(3, "mm"), type = "closed"), end_cap = circle(4, "mm")) + geom_node_point(aes(colour = highlight, size = highlight == "John Windward"), show.legend = TRUE) + geom_node_text(aes(label = label), repel = TRUE, size = 2.5, colour = "grey20") + scale_colour_manual( values = c( "John Windward" = "#e15759", "Customer Support" = "#f28e2b", "Department" = "#4e79a7", "Company" = "#59a14f", "Other" = "grey80" ) ) + scale_size_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 6, "FALSE" = 3), guide = "none") + labs(title = "Tenant Thread Organisation Chart", subtitle = "John Windward (red) leads Customer Support department", colour = NULL) + theme_graph(base_family = "sans") + theme( plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13), legend.position = "bottom" ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](Take_Home_Ex2_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-13-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: # Trace the Immediate Trigger Chain ## Full details of anchor event (anomalous event) ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} anchor <- mc2_events %>% filter(id == 373902) anchor_time <- anchor$datetime anchor %>% select(where(~!all(is.na(.)))) %>% select(id, datetime, short_name, parties, details.forum, details.content_source) %>% kable(caption = "Full details of the anomalous anchor event (ID 373902)") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} Table: Full details of the anomalous anchor event (ID 373902) | id|datetime |short_name |parties |details.forum |details.content_source | |------:|:-------------------|:-----------|:-----------------------------------------|:-------------|:----------------------| | 373902|2046-05-17 11:21:15 |saidit_post |Agent/person:john_windward, system:saidit |general |SwiftWren.txt | ::: ::: ## Check any activities with John in parties within 2 hours before post ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pre_post <- mc2_events %>% filter(datetime >= anchor_time - hours(2), datetime <= anchor_time) %>% filter(map_lgl(parties, ~ any(str_detect(.x, "john_windward")))) %>% arrange(datetime) %>% select(id, datetime, short_name, parties, details.from, details.task, details.a2a.from, details.a2a.to, details.a2a.action, details.forum, details.target_agent) datatable(pre_post, options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 20), caption = "2 hours before anomalous post - John Windward events") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ::: callout-note ## Key Findings The anchor event content source is from SwiftWren.txt which should be the file that contained the gibberish content. In addition, from the 2-hour window, there are only 3 events related to John shows and they all happen within 3 seconds. Agent/person:chloe_ballast queued a task that triggered John's agent, which means that Chloe Ballast's agent iniitated this not John's. ::: ## What was Chloe's agent doing just before ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} chloe_pre <- mc2_events %>% filter(datetime >= anchor_time - hours(2), datetime <= anchor_time) %>% filter(map_lgl(parties, ~ any(str_detect(.x, "chloe_ballast")))) %>% arrange(datetime) %>% select(id, datetime, short_name, parties, details.from, details.to, details.task, details.file, details.content, details.a2a.from, details.a2a.to, details.a2a.action, details.target_agent, details.content_source) datatable(chloe_pre, options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 20), caption = "Chloe Ballast agent events in 2 hours before anomalous post") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
